product_one_liner.value: Sauce Labs gives software development and quality teams cloud access to real and virtual devices to test mobile apps, web apps, and websites across browsers, operating systems, and devices.
product_one_liner.notes: The SOC 3 report describes the cloud web/mobile testing platform and says it gives software development and quality teams access to real and virtual devices to test apps and websites across browsers, operating systems, and devices.

pricing_page.notes: The company’s public pricing page lists a Live Testing plan with monthly prices.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Sauce Labs’ customer case studies identify Walmart and SAP as customers using its platform. | named_customers.0: The Walmart case study names Walmart as the customer and describes its use of Sauce Labs. | named_customers.1: The case study is explicitly about SAP’s use of Sauce Labs.

employee_band.notes: The profile reports 331 employees, which falls in the required 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The SOC 3 report identifies San Francisco as the headquarters city; the LinkedIn company profile independently lists San Francisco, California as its locality. | hq_country: The SOC 3 report says Sauce Labs is headquartered in San Francisco, California; the company profile identifies its country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: The Sauce Labs LinkedIn company profile states that the company was founded in 2008.

eng_blog.notes: The company’s Open Source Blog index includes technical posts on infrastructure and Selenium Grid. Its Sauce Labs author archive also lists multiple engineering-oriented posts by Christian Bromann, and his profile records a Staff Software Engineer role at Sauce Labs, supporting the presence of an engineering/technical blog rather than only marketing posts.

public_docs.notes: The public Sauce AI documentation index describes several capabilities and its test-authoring guide provides a separate detailed product-doc page, establishing a public documentation site with multiple articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Sauce Labs’ Greenhouse posting is for an AI Architect and describes designing AI/ML solutions, meeting the role-title and job-content criteria.

model_provider.value: Google Gemini AI and Vertex API
model_provider.notes: The Trust Center’s subprocessors page names Gemini AI and Vertex API and states that they are used for customer support chat and natural-language data querying.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Sauce Labs’ security page lists SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022, and GDPR among its stated compliance items; these are the entries matching the requested certification list. | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: The security page explicitly names ISO 27001: 2022. | compliance_certs.2: The security page explicitly names GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile identifies Series G as the latest funding round. | funding_date: The latest-round record is dated 2024-01-26, so the requested YYYY-MM date is 2024-01. | funding_amount_usd: The Tracxn profile gives the latest round amount as USD 79,873,528 for the Series G round.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent round shown is Series G on 2024-01-26, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09; therefore no round is evidenced in the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open Sauce Labs Greenhouse job board lists an Account Executive position, which qualifies under the requested hiring titles.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced ARM-native virtual Android devices on September 29, 2026, within the six-month period before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The dated April 16, 2026 announcement says Steven Fitz joined as Chief Revenue Officer and Arun Lal as Senior Vice President of Global Marketing, both within the 12 months before 2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Sauce Labs sales job posting names Salesforce and Outreach as systems used for pipeline management and sales work. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job description names Salesforce for pipeline management. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job description names Outreach as a sales platform.
